title: AI Skill Metadata Schema
description: Machine-readable schema validating metadata.json for skills in Awesome-Claude_Skills.

slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated directory slug matching folder name.

description.description: Concise single-sentence summary for search, indexers, and AI tools.

category.description: Parent category matching directory under skills/.

difficulty.description: Estimated learning and integration difficulty level.

official.description: True if maintained by the official product authors.

official_repository.description: URL to the primary source repository.

official_documentation.description: URL to official project documentation if separate.

supported_models.description: AI models verified to work with this skill.

supported_platforms.description: Operating systems or runtime platforms supported.

supported_ides.description: IDE integrations supported (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code).

related_skills.description: Slugs of complementary or related skills.

keywords.description: Indexing keywords for semantic search and CLI search.

version.description: Documentation version of this skill package.

maintainer.description: Maintainer or organization responsible for this skill doc.
